title: Atlanta Street Art and BeltLine Tour with Happy Hour and Activity
includes: Guided tour of Cabbagetown and Eastside BeltLine trail
Supplies to make your own art
Exclusive resource guide for Atlanta street art
Hotel pick up and drop off (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Restrooms are located at the end of the tour (at our last stop) as Cabbagetown businesses' restrooms are for paying customers only. If you need to use the restroom beforehand you can do so 1 mile from the starting point at Krog Street Market.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore some of the city’s most famous murals, graffiti, and installations on a guided walking tour of Cabbagetown, Krog Street Tunnel, and the Atlanta Beltline. 

A knowledgeable, engaging tour guide will take you through these iconic neighborhoods to view stunning and impactful art, hear stories behind the art and artists, help you interpret the art by providing prompts, and help you get those perfect ‘grammable shots. 
Plus, you’ll become art critics and artists yourself as you design your own street art during an art salon-style happy hour.
